name: TecAdRise Bot
tagline: Free open-source Grok Bot alternative for Windows, with local multi-agent chat.
description: TecAdRise Bot is a free open-source Windows Electron host for local AI agents. It uses the Cursor SDK so you can run multiple agents on your own PC with skills, scheduled routines, inter-bot messages, and a localhost control plane. It is built for people who want always-on personal agents on hardware they own, as an alternative to hosted Grok Bot.
